name: Shirakawa Satone
source:
A junior from Shouma's high school days who was in the same club activities. She is a very devoted and earnest person and is currently working as a nurse.
While worrying about her husband, who is younger then her, and feels as if he hasn't grown up from his student days, she encounters Shouma who she hasn't seen in a long time.
